ex.en: The band marched through the square in bright uniforms.
ex.zh: 乐队身穿鲜艳的制服，齐步走过广场。

ex.en: Residents organised a peaceful march to demand safer roads and better public transport in their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 居民组织了一场和平游行，要求改善社区道路安全和公共交通。

col: march through the streets｜列队穿过街道
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。小写march指行进；大写March指三月。

ex.en: My grandparents live in a quiet village in this county.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母住在这个郡里一个安静的村庄。

ex.en: The county council plans to improve public transport between rural communities and the nearest city.
ex.zh: 郡议会计划改善乡村社区与最近城市之间的公共交通。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。英国的county通常译为“郡”，美国的译为“县”。

senses.zh: 作战；参加竞选；参加活动

ex.en: Our school launched a campaign to reduce food waste.
ex.zh: 我们学校发起了一项减少食物浪费的活动。

ex.en: Public health campaigns can encourage healthier habits, especially when supported by affordable access to nutritious food.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传活动能促进更健康的习惯，尤其是在居民能够负担并获得营养食物的情况下。

col: an advertising campaign｜广告宣传活动
campaign for reform｜为改革开展运动
campaign against pollution｜开展反污染运动
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。动词后接for表示争取，接against表示反对。

senses.zh: 成为王后或其他大于卒的子

ex.en: Our local club promotes cycling through free weekend rides.
ex.zh: 我们当地的俱乐部通过免费的周末骑行活动推广骑车。

ex.en: Schools can promote healthier lifestyles by providing nutritious meals and encouraging students to take regular exercise.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过提供营养餐并鼓励学生定期锻炼来倡导更健康的生活方式。

col: promote economic growth｜促进经济增长
be promoted to manager｜获晋升为经理
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。晋升到某职位用be promoted to＋职位。

senses.zh: 可以再度使用的，可重复使用的

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A

senses.zh: 强烈的欲望，迫切要求；推动力

ex.en: I resisted the urge to eat another biscuit.
ex.zh: 我忍住了再吃一块饼干的冲动。

ex.en: Health experts urge governments to invest in preventive care rather than focus solely on treating diseases.
ex.zh: 健康专家敦促政府投资预防保健，而不是只关注疾病治疗。

col: urge someone to do something｜敦促某人做某事
a strong urge to｜想……的强烈冲动
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。动词用urge sb to do；名词用an urge to do。

ex.en: A sudden movement in the bushes caught my attention.
ex.zh: 灌木丛里突然有动静，引起了我的注意。

ex.en: The environmental movement has encouraged governments to adopt stronger policies on waste reduction and renewable energy.
ex.zh: 环保运动推动各国政府在减少废物和发展可再生能源方面采取更有力的政策。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。指具体动作或社会运动时可数；泛指移动可不可数。

ex.en: We spent a rainy afternoon exploring the local gallery.
ex.zh: 一个下雨的下午，我们逛了当地的美术馆。

ex.en: Free entry to a public gallery can make visual art accessible to people from different economic backgrounds.
ex.zh: 公共美术馆免费开放，可以让不同经济背景的人都有机会接触视觉艺术。

col: public gallery｜公共美术馆；旁听席
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。gallery主要展示艺术品；museum涵盖的展品范围更广。

ex.en: The museum displays a robe once worn by an emperor.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了一件皇帝曾穿过的袍子。

ex.en: The emperor expanded trade routes, allowing goods and cultural practices to spread across the empire.
ex.zh: 这位皇帝拓展了贸易路线，使商品和文化习俗得以在帝国各地传播。

col: crown someone emperor｜为某人加冕称帝
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。emperor统治empire；empress指女皇或皇后。

senses.zh: 砖，砖块；砖形物；心肠好的人

ex.en: One loose brick fell out of the garden wall.
ex.zh: 花园围墙上掉下了一块松动的砖。

ex.en: Reusing brick from demolished buildings can reduce construction waste and preserve the character of older neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 重复利用拆除建筑中的砖可以减少建筑垃圾，并保留老街区的特色。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。单块砖可数；作建筑材料统称时可不可数。

senses.zh: 最新的，最近的；最迟的，最后的

ex.en: Have you heard the latest news about our neighbour?
ex.zh: 你听说关于我们邻居的最新消息了吗？

ex.en: The latest research suggests that regular physical activity can improve both memory and mental health.
ex.zh: 最新研究表明，规律运动可以改善记忆力和心理健康。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A。latest指最新；last常指上一个或最后一个。

senses.zh: 发生差别；使…有差别；(结果等)是重要的

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A

senses.zh: 基于；以……为基础；以…为根据

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A

senses.zh: 纳米比亚（非洲西南部国家）

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 A

senses.zh: 寄宿制学校；寄宿中学；寄宿制私立中学

ex.en: Amir shares a room with two friends at boarding school.
ex.zh: 阿米尔在寄宿学校与两个朋友同住一间房。

ex.en: Attending boarding school can foster independence, although some children find prolonged separation from their families difficult.
ex.zh: 就读寄宿学校可以培养独立性，但有些孩子觉得长期与家人分离很难适应。

col: attend boarding school｜就读寄宿学校
send a child to boarding school｜送孩子去寄宿学校
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。boarding指食宿；寄宿学校既提供教学也提供住宿。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B

senses.zh: 收集，整理；小卡车；拾起；搭车者；偶然结识者

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B

ex.en: We play soccer in the park every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。

ex.en: Community soccer clubs provide affordable exercise and help young people develop teamwork skills outside the classroom.
ex.zh: 社区足球俱乐部提供费用低廉的锻炼机会，帮助年轻人在课堂之外培养团队协作能力。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。英式英语通常称football，美式称soccer。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B

senses.zh: 训练；教导；培育（educate的过去分词形式）

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B

senses.zh: 交付；发表；递送；释放；给予（打击）；给…接生

ex.en: The bakery delivers warm bread to our door every morning.
ex.zh: 面包店每天早上把热乎乎的面包送到我们家门口。

ex.en: Public transport projects must deliver clear benefits to local residents if they are to justify substantial investment.
ex.zh: 公共交通项目必须为当地居民带来明确的益处，才能证明大规模投资是合理的。

col: deliver on a promise｜兑现承诺
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。递送用deliver sth to sb；兑现承诺可用deliver on。

ex.en: Construction of the new bridge started early this morning.
ex.zh: 新桥的建设今天一早开始了。

ex.en: The construction of energy-efficient housing can reduce household bills and limit the environmental impact of urban growth.
ex.zh: 建设节能住宅可以降低家庭账单支出，并减少城市扩张对环境的影响。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。表示建造过程时不可数；under construction指在建。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B

ex.en: The model shows the structure of a wooden bridge.
ex.zh: 这个模型展示了一座木桥的结构。

ex.en: A clear essay structure helps readers follow complex arguments and understand the writer's main conclusions.
ex.zh: 清晰的文章结构有助于读者理解复杂的论证，把握作者的主要结论。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。structure既可作名词，也可作动词表示组织、安排。

ex.en: We hired a van to move our furniture.
ex.zh: 我们租了一辆货车来搬家具。

ex.en: Businesses that hire local workers can strengthen regional economies and reduce the need for long commutes.
ex.zh: 雇用当地员工的企业可以增强区域经济，并减少长途通勤的需要。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。租车英式常用hire，美式常用rent。

senses.zh: 尴尬的；笨拙的；棘手的；不合适的

ex.en: There was an awkward silence after I forgot her name.
ex.zh: 我忘了她的名字，随后出现了一阵尴尬的沉默。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help parents manage awkward schedules without sacrificing their career opportunities.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排可以帮助家长应对难以协调的日程，而不必牺牲职业机会。

col: an awkward question｜难回答的问题
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。awkward可指社交尴尬，也可指动作笨拙。

ex.en: Despite her first failure, she tried baking bread again.
ex.zh: 尽管第一次失败了，她还是再次尝试烤面包。

ex.en: Schools should treat failure as an opportunity for learning rather than as evidence of a student's limited ability.
ex.zh: 学校应将失败视为学习的机会，而不是学生能力有限的证明。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。泛指失败通常不可数；a failure可指失败的事物。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B

senses.zh: 带，环； 波段；(演奏流行音乐的) 乐队

ex.en: My sister plays the drums in a local band.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在当地一支乐队里打鼓。

ex.en: Live bands at community festivals can attract visitors and create opportunities for local businesses.
ex.zh: 社区节庆中的现场乐队演出能吸引游客，并为当地商家创造机会。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。IELTS中的band指成绩等级，不是乐队。

senses.zh: 合逻辑的，合理的；逻辑学的

ex.en: Taking the bus seemed logical because parking was expensive.
ex.zh: 停车费很贵，所以乘公交车似乎很合理。

ex.en: Students should learn to construct logical arguments rather than simply memorise facts for examinations.
ex.zh: 学生应该学习如何构建合乎逻辑的论证，而不是仅仅为考试背诵事实。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。logical强调推理合理，不表示事实一定正确。

senses.zh: 流行的；时髦的；上流社会的

ex.en: Those colourful trainers are fashionable among my friends.
ex.zh: 那种彩色运动鞋在我的朋友中很流行。

ex.en: Consumers often replace fashionable clothing quickly, increasing textile waste and placing pressure on natural resources.
ex.zh: 消费者往往很快就更换时髦的服装，增加了纺织废料，也给自然资源带来压力。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。不仅形容衣服，也可形容观念、活动或地区。

ex.en: The apple was crisp and sweet with every bite.
ex.zh: 这个苹果每咬一口都又脆又甜。

ex.en: Packaging helps keep snacks crisp, but excessive use of plastic creates significant environmental problems.
ex.zh: 包装有助于保持零食酥脆，但过度使用塑料会造成严重的环境问题。

col: a packet of crisps｜一包薯片
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。薯片英式常用复数crisps，美式说potato chips。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B

senses.zh: 统一的；一致的；相同的；均衡的；始终如一的

ex.en: My school uniform is still drying by the window.
ex.zh: 我的校服还在窗边晾着。

ex.en: Uniform safety standards across all factories can help protect workers and improve overall working conditions.
ex.zh: 所有工厂实行统一的安全标准，有助于保护工人并改善整体工作条件。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。开头是辅音/j/，所以说a uniform，不用an。

senses.zh: 常客；正式队员；中坚分子
定期的；有规律的；合格的；整齐的；普通的

ex.en: Our dog needs regular walks to stay happy and healthy.
ex.zh: 我们的狗需要经常散步，才能保持快乐和健康。

ex.en: Regular exercise can reduce the risk of chronic disease and improve overall wellbeing in older adults.
ex.zh: 规律运动可以降低老年人患慢性病的风险，并改善其整体身心健康。

col: at regular intervals｜每隔固定时间
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。regular侧重规律或经常，不等于持续不停的continuous。

ex.en: The farmer checked his wheat crop after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨过后，农民查看了自己的小麦。

ex.en: Rising temperatures may reduce crop yields, threatening food security in regions that already experience water shortages.
ex.zh: 气温上升可能导致农作物减产，威胁本就缺水地区的粮食安全。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。crop既指庄稼也指收成；动词可指裁剪照片。

senses.zh: 调节，规定；控制；校准；有系统的管理

ex.en: This small device helps regulate the temperature indoors.
ex.zh: 这个小装置有助于调节室内温度。

ex.en: Governments should regulate industrial emissions to protect public health without placing unnecessary burdens on small businesses.
ex.zh: 政府应监管工业排放，在保护公众健康的同时，避免给小企业增加不必要的负担。

col: regulate an industry｜监管一个行业
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。及物动词，直接接宾语；regulate temperature指调温。

ex.en: We checked the official website before booking our tickets.
ex.zh: 我们订票前查看了官方网站。

ex.en: Official statistics indicate that investment in public transport has increased steadily over the past decade.
ex.zh: 官方统计数据显示，过去十年公共交通投资持续增长。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。official强调官方认可；formal强调形式或场合正式。

ex.en: I need a haircut before my cousin's wedding.
ex.zh: 表亲的婚礼之前，我需要理个发。

ex.en: Offering affordable haircuts at community centres can help trainee hairdressers gain practical experience while serving local residents.
ex.zh: 在社区中心提供价格实惠的理发服务，能让实习理发师在服务当地居民的同时积累实践经验。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。说get或have a haircut，不说cut a haircut。

senses.zh: 生产力；生产率；生产能力

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B

ex.en: Our village shares its water resources during dry summers.
ex.zh: 在干旱的夏季，我们村会共享水资源。

ex.en: Governments should manage natural resources carefully to balance economic development with long-term environmental protection.
ex.zh: 政府应谨慎管理自然资源，以平衡经济发展与长期环境保护。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。资源总称常用复数resources；动词意为提供资源。

ex.en: Please don't criticize my cooking before you taste it.
ex.zh: 请别还没尝就批评我的厨艺。

ex.en: Many residents criticize the council for prioritizing road construction over improvements to public transport.
ex.zh: 许多居民批评地方议会优先修建道路，而非改善公共交通。

col: criticize someone for something｜因某事批评某人
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。criticize sb for sth；英式也常拼作criticise。

ex.en: I had no intention of staying out so late.
ex.zh: 我原本没打算在外面待到这么晚。

ex.en: The government announced its intention to expand public transport in order to reduce traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 政府宣布计划扩大公共交通服务，以缓解交通拥堵。

col: with the intention of｜抱着…的目的
announce an intention to｜宣布做…的打算
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。用intention to do或intention of doing。

senses.zh: 僭取；篡夺；夺取；擅用；侵占

ex.en: Don't assume the shop is open on Sundays.
ex.zh: 别想当然地以为这家店周日营业。

ex.en: Policymakers should not assume that all households have reliable internet access or adequate digital skills.
ex.zh: 政策制定者不应假定所有家庭都有稳定的网络连接或足够的数字技能。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B。assume常接that从句，强调未经证实便认为。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B

senses.zh: 导致；引起；把…一直带领到

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B

senses.zh: 出轨；出岔子；(话)离题；(猎狗)失去嗅迹
场外荣耀；仕途上脱离正途；思路就会导致文章最终跑题

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 2 B

ex.en: Swimming every morning has really improved my endurance.
ex.zh: 每天早晨游泳确实增强了我的耐力。

ex.en: Regular physical activity builds endurance and helps people manage the demands of an increasingly sedentary lifestyle.
ex.zh: 经常运动能增强耐力，帮助人们应对日益久坐的生活方式带来的挑战。

col: a test of endurance｜耐力考验
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。通常不可数，强调在疲劳或困难中坚持的能力。

ex.en: I saw an advertisement for bicycles at the station.
ex.zh: 我在车站看到了一则自行车广告。

ex.en: Advertisements aimed at young consumers should present accurate information rather than encourage unnecessary spending.
ex.zh: 面向年轻消费者的广告应提供准确信息，而不是鼓励不必要的消费。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。广告内容用 for 引出；advertising 泛指广告活动。

senses.zh: 有危险的；冒险的；碰运气的

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A

ex.en: The café pays a decent wage for weekend work.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆给周末上班的员工支付不错的工资。

ex.en: Raising the minimum wage may improve living standards, but small businesses could face higher operating costs.
ex.zh: 提高最低工资可能改善生活水平，但小企业可能面临更高的经营成本。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。wage常按小时或周计算；salary通常指固定薪金。

senses.zh: 探险家；勘探者；探测器；探针

ex.en: The explorer carried a compass through the dense forest.
ex.zh: 探险者带着指南针穿过茂密的森林。

ex.en: An explorer can contribute valuable observations, but expeditions should avoid disturbing local wildlife and communities.
ex.zh: 探险者可以提供宝贵的观察资料，但探险活动应避免干扰当地野生动物和社区。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。explorer指探险的人，exploration指探索活动。

ex.en: We travelled to the coast via a small mountain village.
ex.zh: 我们途经一个山间小村庄，前往海岸。

ex.en: Providing medical advice via video calls can improve access to healthcare for people in remote communities.
ex.zh: 通过视频通话提供医疗建议，可以让偏远社区的居民更容易获得医疗服务。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。via后直接接地点或方式，如via email。

senses.en: A long, narrow stick or post, often used for support.
Either of two opposite ends of Earth, a magnet, or battery.
Either of two completely opposite positions or qualities.

ex.en: We used a long pole to support the tent.
ex.zh: 我们用一根长杆撑起帐篷。

ex.en: Climate change is affecting both poles, although the environmental consequences differ significantly between the two regions.
ex.zh: 气候变化正影响着南北两极，但两个地区面临的环境后果存在显著差异。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。pole与poll同音；地理名称the North Pole需大写。

ex.en: We packed warm clothes for our expedition into the mountains.
ex.zh: 我们为进山探险打包了保暖衣物。

ex.en: A scientific expedition to the polar regions collected valuable evidence of changes in sea ice.
ex.zh: 一支前往极地的科学考察队收集了海冰变化的重要证据。

col: an expedition to Antarctica｜南极考察
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。expedition多指有组织、有特定目的的远行。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A

senses.zh: 冰冻的；严寒的；冷冻用的

ex.en: My hands were freezing after waiting outside for the bus.
ex.zh: 在外面等公交车后，我的双手冰冷。

ex.en: Freezing temperatures can damage water pipes and disrupt essential services, particularly in areas with ageing infrastructure.
ex.zh: 冰冻天气可能损坏水管并扰乱基本服务，尤其是在基础设施老化的地区。

col: freezing temperatures｜冰点及以下的气温
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。I'm freezing表示我冷极了，不一定真的结冰。

ex.en: Dinner was a disaster because I burned the rice.
ex.zh: 晚餐糟透了，因为我把米饭烧焦了。

ex.en: Effective early warning systems can reduce the damage caused by natural disasters and help communities recover more quickly.
ex.zh: 有效的预警系统可以减少自然灾害造成的损失，并帮助社区更快恢复。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。也可夸张形容失败：The party was a disaster。

senses.zh: 使融化；使熔化；使软化；使感动

ex.en: The butter melted quickly in the warm pan.
ex.zh: 黄油在温热的平底锅里很快就化了。

ex.en: As global temperatures rise, mountain glaciers melt faster, threatening freshwater supplies for communities downstream.
ex.zh: 随着全球气温上升，山地冰川融化加快，威胁着下游社区的淡水供应。

col: melt someone's heart｜打动某人的心
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。melt指受热融化；dissolve指溶于液体。

senses.zh: 队，组；全体人员，全体船员

ex.en: The crew welcomed us aboard with warm smiles.
ex.zh: 机组人员面带亲切的笑容，欢迎我们登机。

ex.en: Airlines must ensure that every crew member receives regular safety training to protect passengers during emergencies.
ex.zh: 航空公司必须确保每位机组成员定期接受安全培训，以便在紧急情况下保护乘客。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。crew是集体名词；单个成员说a crew member。

ex.en: We had to abandon our car in the snow.
ex.zh: 我们不得不将车弃在雪地里。

ex.en: Cities should not abandon ambitious recycling programmes simply because initial participation rates are lower than expected.
ex.zh: 城市不应仅因初期参与率低于预期，就放弃雄心勃勃的回收计划。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。abandon直接接宾语；名词常见于with abandon。

ex.en: The little toy boat sank beneath the bathwater.
ex.zh: 那只小玩具船沉到了洗澡水下面。

ex.en: Coastal communities face increasing risks as land sinks and sea levels rise because of climate change.
ex.zh: 随着地面下沉以及气候变化导致的海平面上升，沿海社区面临日益严峻的风险。

col: sink to the bottom｜沉到底部
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。不规则变化：sink—sank—sunk。

senses.zh: 幸存；生还；幸免于；比...活得长

ex.en: Our little cactus survived three weeks without water.
ex.zh: 我们的小仙人掌三个星期没浇水也活下来了。

ex.en: Small businesses are more likely to survive economic downturns when they maintain strong relationships with local customers.
ex.zh: 小企业若与本地顾客保持牢固联系，就更有可能挺过经济低迷期。

col: survive an accident｜在事故中幸存
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。表示从事故中幸存，直接说survive an accident。

senses.zh: 彩车，花车；漂流物；浮舟；浮萍
浮动；飘动，散播；摇摆；付诸实施

ex.en: A yellow leaf floated gently across the garden pond.
ex.zh: 一片黄叶轻轻漂过花园里的池塘。

ex.en: Researchers have floated the idea of using artificial islands to provide additional housing in crowded coastal cities.
ex.zh: 研究人员提出了利用人工岛为拥挤的沿海城市提供更多住房的想法。

col: float an idea｜提出一个想法
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。float an idea是提出想法供讨论，并非实施。

ex.en: The crew lowered the lifeboat carefully into the sea.
ex.zh: 船员小心地把救生艇放入海中。

ex.en: Coastal communities rely on trained lifeboat crews to rescue swimmers and sailors during emergencies at sea.
ex.zh: 沿海社区依靠训练有素的救生艇船员，在海上紧急情况下营救游泳者和船员。

col: launch a lifeboat｜使救生艇下水
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。lifeboat是救生艇；life jacket是救生衣。

senses.zh: 耗尽；用尽；使…精疲力尽（exhaust的过去式）

ex.en: After carrying those boxes upstairs, I felt completely exhausted.
ex.zh: 把那些箱子搬上楼后，我感到筋疲力尽。

ex.en: Employees who are constantly exhausted may struggle to concentrate, increasing the risk of mistakes at work.
ex.zh: 长期疲惫不堪的员工可能难以集中注意力，从而增加工作中出错的风险。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。人感到累用exhausted；事情令人累用exhausting。

ex.en: Firefighters rescued a kitten from the roof this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，消防员从屋顶救下了一只小猫。

ex.en: Coastal communities need well-equipped teams to rescue residents when severe flooding blocks roads and damages homes.
ex.zh: 沿海社区需要装备精良的队伍，在严重洪灾阻断道路、损坏房屋时营救居民。

col: rescue someone from｜从……中救出某人
come to the rescue｜前来解围
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。常用rescue sb from sth，表示从险境中救出某人。

senses.zh: 挪威的；挪威语的；挪威人的

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A

ex.en: The harbour museum has an exhibition about whaling.
ex.zh: 港口博物馆有一个关于捕鲸的展览。

ex.en: Commercial whaling has contributed to declining whale populations, prompting international efforts to protect these marine mammals.
ex.zh: 商业捕鲸导致鲸类数量下降，促使国际社会努力保护这些海洋哺乳动物。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。不可数名词；谈捕鲸禁令用ban on whaling。

senses.zh: 耗尽；使…精疲力竭；排出（exhaust的ing形式）
使筋疲力尽的；使耗尽的

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A

senses.zh: 用帐篷遮盖；使在帐篷里住宿

ex.en: We pitched our tent beside a quiet lake.
ex.zh: 我们在一个宁静的湖边搭起帐篷。

ex.en: Visitors who sleep in a tent should follow campsite rules to minimise their impact on local wildlife.
ex.zh: 住帐篷的游客应遵守营地规定，尽量减少对当地野生动物的影响。

col: put up a tent｜搭起帐篷
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。“搭帐篷”用pitch或put up a tent。

ex.en: Without regular feeding, these rescued animals could starve.
ex.zh: 如果不定期喂食，这些获救的动物可能会饿死。

ex.en: When drought destroys crops, rural families may starve unless emergency food supplies reach them quickly.
ex.zh: 当干旱毁坏庄稼时，如果紧急食品不能及时送达，农村家庭可能会挨饿。

col: be starved of resources｜严重缺乏资源
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。日常说I'm starving表示饿极了，并非濒临饿死。

senses.zh: 结冰（freeze的过去分词）；凝固；变得刻板

ex.en: A frozen puddle cracked beneath my boot this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，一处结冰的水洼被我的靴子踩裂了。

ex.en: Frozen vegetables can help households reduce food waste because they remain usable much longer than fresh produce.
ex.zh: 冷冻蔬菜的保存时间比新鲜农产品长得多，因此可以帮助家庭减少食物浪费。

col: frozen with fear｜吓得动弹不得
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。也是freeze的过去分词；过去式为froze。

senses.zh: 智利文化的；智利人的；智利的

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A

ex.en: We sailed across the lake on a sunny afternoon.
ex.zh: 一个晴朗的下午，我们乘船驶过湖面。

ex.en: Ships that sail through sensitive marine habitats should follow strict rules to protect wildlife.
ex.zh: 驶经敏感海洋栖息地的船只应遵守严格规定，以保护野生动物。

col: sail across the ocean｜航行穿越大洋
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。作动词不限于帆船，也可指轮船航行。

ex.en: Our teacher pointed to the African continent on a globe.
ex.zh: 老师指着地球仪上的非洲大陆。

ex.en: Climate change affects every continent, although its consequences vary considerably between regions and communities.
ex.zh: 气候变化影响每一个洲，但其后果因地区和群体而有很大差异。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。continent是洲或大陆，country是国家。

ex.en: Our dog buried its favourite toy beside the fence.
ex.zh: 我们的狗把最喜欢的玩具埋在了篱笆旁。

ex.en: Instead of burying household waste, local authorities should invest in recycling facilities and public education.
ex.zh: 地方政府不应只是填埋生活垃圾，而应投资建设回收设施并开展公众教育。

col: bury your face in｜把脸埋进
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。发音同berry；过去式buried，动名词burying。

ex.en: The young violinist gave an exceptional performance last night.
ex.zh: 那位年轻的小提琴手昨晚的演奏十分出色。

ex.en: Students with exceptional ability may require additional challenges to remain engaged in classroom learning.
ex.zh: 能力出众的学生可能需要更有挑战性的任务，才能持续投入课堂学习。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。常指特别优秀；exceptional circumstances指特殊情况。

ex.en: Her calm leadership helped our team finish the project.
ex.zh: 她沉着的领导帮助我们团队完成了项目。

ex.en: Effective leadership in schools can improve staff morale and create a more supportive learning environment.
ex.zh: 有效的学校领导可以提升教职工士气，并营造更有支持性的学习环境。

col: under the leadership of｜在……的领导下
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。通常不可数；可指领导能力，也可指领导层。

ex.en: The view from the mountain was unbelievable at sunrise.
ex.zh: 日出时山上的景色美得令人难以置信。

ex.en: Some online advertisements promise unbelievable results, making it difficult for consumers to distinguish evidence from exaggeration.
ex.zh: 一些网络广告承诺令人难以置信的效果，使消费者难以区分实证与夸大宣传。

col: an unbelievable story｜难以置信的故事
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。既可表示不可信，也可口语强调极好或极糟。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A

ex.en: My cousin photographed penguins during a trip to Antarctica.
ex.zh: 我表亲去南极洲旅行时拍了企鹅的照片。

ex.en: Scientists studying Antarctica analyse ancient ice to understand how the Earth's climate has changed over time.
ex.zh: 研究南极洲的科学家通过分析古老冰层，了解地球气候如何随时间变化。

col: the coast of Antarctica｜南极洲海岸
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A。洲名首字母大写，前面通常不加the。

senses.zh: 南极点；南极生态；在南极

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A

senses.zh: 南乔治亚岛；南乔治亚州；南格鲁吉亚

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 A
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B

senses.zh: 印象；效果，影响；压痕，印记；感想；曝光（衡量广告被显示的次数。打开一个带有该广告的网页，则该广告的impression 次数增加一次）

ex.en: Her warm welcome gave me a good first impression.
ex.zh: 她热情的欢迎给我留下了良好的第一印象。

ex.en: The appearance of public spaces can strongly influence visitors' overall impression of a city.
ex.zh: 公共空间的面貌会显著影响游客对城市的整体印象。

col: make an impression on｜给……留下印象
be under the impression that｜以为……
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。under the impression that表示“以为”，常暗示误解。

ex.en: The sailor tied the boat securely to the dock.
ex.zh: 水手把船牢牢地系在码头上。

ex.en: Modern navigation technology helps sailors avoid dangerous waters, but practical experience remains essential for safety at sea.
ex.zh: 现代导航技术帮助海员避开危险水域，但实践经验对海上安全仍至关重要。

col: a crew of sailors｜一组船员
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。指在船上工作或驾驶帆船的人，不泛指乘客。

senses.zh: 潜水；跳水；俯冲；急剧下降

ex.en: We watched a swimmer dive smoothly into the pool.
ex.zh: 我们看着一名游泳者流畅地跃入泳池。

ex.en: Tourists who dive near coral reefs should avoid touching marine organisms to prevent damage to fragile ecosystems.
ex.zh: 在珊瑚礁附近潜水的游客应避免触碰海洋生物，以免破坏脆弱的生态系统。

col: dive into the water｜跃入水中
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。过去式英式常用dived，美式也用dove。

ex.en: Check the depth before you jump into the pool.
ex.zh: 跳进泳池前先确认水深。

ex.en: University courses should encourage students to explore complex environmental issues in greater depth.
ex.zh: 大学课程应鼓励学生更深入地探讨复杂的环境问题。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。in depth表示“深入地”，不是“在深处”。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B

senses.zh: 决定；溶解；使…分解；决心要做…

ex.en: We resolved the argument by taking turns cooking dinner.
ex.zh: 我们通过轮流做晚饭解决了这场争执。

ex.en: International cooperation is essential to resolve disputes over shared water resources and prevent future conflicts.
ex.zh: 国际合作对于解决共享水资源争端和预防未来冲突至关重要。

col: resolve to do something｜决心做某事
strengthen someone's resolve｜坚定某人的决心
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。resolve a problem是解决；resolve to do是决心做。

senses.zh: 不顾一切的；令人绝望的；极度渴望的

ex.en: Desperate to find her cat, Aisha searched every nearby garden.
ex.zh: 艾莎急切地想找到她的猫，搜遍了附近每个花园。

ex.en: After prolonged drought, farming communities face desperate conditions and require urgent support to restore their livelihoods.
ex.zh: 长期干旱后，农业社区面临危急处境，急需援助以恢复生计。

col: a desperate attempt｜孤注一掷的尝试
desperate measures｜不得已的极端措施
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。渴望某物用desperate for；急切做某事用to do。
